title: The Vault Where All Cycles Converge Into One Spiral

features.name: spiral shed row
features.desc-on-touch: Three small wooden sheds arranged in a tightening spiral. Each one holds a different year's harvest. They are waiting for the spiral to complete so they can begin again.

features.name: central archive house
features.desc-on-touch: A small cottage at the spiral's center holds every cycle that has ever completed. The building's angles refuse to align with its foundation, because the spiral underneath has not stopped moving.

features.name: cycle-ledger stone
features.desc-on-touch: A standing stone carved with spiraling lines that mark completed years. The carving continues beyond the stone's surface into the ground, where it records futures that haven't arrived yet.

features.name: return-path marker
features.desc-on-touch: A spiral painted on the ground in clay and seeds. It shows where each spring returns to, and where it leaves from next. The path is the same forward and backward; only the speed changes.

features.name: convergence gate
features.desc-on-touch: An archway built from cycles that have learned to stack. You pass through it and realize the archway is also the spiral, also the vault, also your own return.

inscription: all spirals converge to the same point, but the point is not the center — it is the memory that the beginning and the end never stopped touching

file.name: Cycle_Convergence_Study_Spring_Annotations.txt
file.note: field notes on patterns observed in spiraling archives. The notes spiral too. Each spring's annotation is written by the spring that came before. The handwriting improves with repetition.

exits.label: back down to where the spiral was younger
upward to where cycles learn to fly outward
westward to where other cycles are still converging
